REWORK

`planner.mjs` accepts jobs with unknown extra fields. R1 defines normalized parser output as objects containing exactly five fields; R2 requires planner inputs to be normalized jobs and to reject invalid entries rather than normalize them. `validateJob` checks required field values but never rejects additional own properties.

Recorded test execution did pass: 10/10 tests, exit 0. However, that evidence does not cover this contract boundary, so success cannot be accepted.

scope: CLI implementation and independent same-model review; supervising subagent/root/setup attribution separate, not an invoice or full workflow savings
